shr_audit.root_cause_explanation: In Stage 8.9.21, chaotic screams caused autocorrelation pitch tracking failure (f0_mean = 0.0), which automatically fell into the default branch (shr_db = -30.0 dB). In contrast, shouted speech had a stable fundamental frequency (150-180 Hz) whose subharmonic frequencies (F0/3 = 50-60 Hz) directly coincided with mains electricity hum (50/60 Hz) and HVAC rumble. The legacy algorithm integrated this ambient hum as subharmonic energy, artificially inflating shouting SHR to -10.68 dB.

tier2_identical_metrics_audit.root_cause_explanation: In Stage 8.9.21 two_tier_classifier.py, evaluate_tri_state had a thresholding and fail-safe logic: Candidates with Tier 1 score < 0.35 were early-rejected (decision = 0). Candidates with Tier 1 score >= 0.35 were only suppressed if Tier 2 score s2 < 0.35 without triggering the chaotic safeguard. In the held-out test split, all 91 Tier 1 positive samples either had s2 >= 0.40 or triggered the UNCERTAIN fail-safe (which explicitly set final_decision = 1 to preserve recall). As a result, Tier 2 modified zero samples on the primary test cohort, rendering final predictions 100% identical to the Tier 1 baseline across all five candidate models.
